=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  Line or code reference: lines 6795-6799, the `attempts_label` fallback when no `editor_attempt_*.err` files exist
  Problem: The `wc -l | tr -d '[:space:]'` pipeline at line 6786 yields the empty string (not "0") when `ls` produces no matching files and `wc` reads zero lines from empty stdin. `set -e` is not active in this step block, and the `|| true` guard at line 6786 absorbs the pipefail from `wc`, so `editor_attempts` resolves to an empty string. The `[ "${editor_attempts:-0}" -eq 1 ]` test at line 6796 guards with `${editor_attempts:-0}`, which defaults empty to `0`, so `-eq 1` is false. The `-gt 1` test at line 6798 is also false. The fallback `attempts_label="every attempt"` is reached correctly. No runtime failure.
  Why it fails at runtime: Does not fail. The guard `|| true` and `${editor_attempts:-0}` default together handle the empty-string case correctly. This is a non-issue confirmed by the test at lines 1164-1181.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 1

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- file: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml
  location: lines ~6787-6790 (the two `editor_last_error="$(... )"` pipelines feeding the recoverable-failure branch)
  issue: `editor_last_error` is taken verbatim from third-party provider stderr (`^Error: ` lines or `level=ERROR ... error="..."` opencode frames) and embedded into the PR comment inside a single-backtick inline-code span (`Last provider error from the final attempt: \`${editor_last_error}\``). A backtick anywhere in the captured text would close the span early and break the markdown render of everything that follows in the body. The capture clips to 240 characters, so an embedded backtick is the realistic break risk.
  suggested minimal fix: append `| tr -d '\140'` (or `tr -d '`'` ) to both `editor_last_error` capture pipelines so backticks are stripped before the variable reaches the markdown template.
  estimated lines changed: 2
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
